about: I'm Ashwin Rajakrishna, a Networking & Cybersecurity student at the University of Ontario Institute of Technology (UOIT). I bring hands-on IT experience from supporting 200+ users globally, configuring enterprise infrastructure, and driving measurable improvements in system reliability.

Beyond tech, I'm an entrepreneur at heart — I founded MechMania, a robotics competition that secured $4,000 in funding and brought five schools together for its inaugural event. I thrive where technical skill meets initiative.

education.institution: University of Ontario Institute of Technology

experience.title: IT Analyst
bullets: Maintained and monitored 15+ company servers and core network systems, supporting 200+ global employees.
Configured and deployed new workstations, laptops, VOIP, and mobile devices including OS installation, software setup, and security configuration.
Provided Tier 1/2 IT support for 200+ users worldwide, resolving 90%+ of hardware, software, and network issues on first response.
Monitored network performance (DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN) and resolved connectivity issues, reducing recurring network incidents by 25%.
Performed routine system maintenance, software updates, and infrastructure monitoring, improving system reliability by 20%.
